# Security policy

## Supported versions

Fixes go into the latest release of ReTerraForged for each supported Minecraft version: 1.21.1, 1.21.3, 1.21.4,
1.21.5, 1.21.8, 1.21.10, 1.21.11, 26.1.2, 26.2 and 26.3, on NeoForge and Fabric. Older releases are not updated.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem (for example a crafted preset or datapack that crashes a
server or reads files it should not). Report it privately through GitHub instead:
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Vladeezyy/reterraforged/security/advisories/new).

Include the Minecraft version, the loader, the ReTerraForged version and the steps to reproduce. You will get an
answer there; once a fix is released the advisory is published with credit to you, if you like.
